⚡ Create Cozy Chaos ⚙️

The definitive Next-Gen Create & Aeronautics experience. Fully optimized, multiplayer-ready, and packed with endless creativity.

--- ## 🔮 Overview **Create Cozy Chaos** is a meticulously crafted modpack that strikes the perfect balance between relaxed, cozy exploration and chaotic mechanical engineering. Built from the ground up to support the highly anticipated **Create Aeronautics**, this pack lets you break the boundaries of blocks and build fully moving, physics-based airships, factories, and contraptions. --- ## 🛠️ Feature Matrix | Category | Highlights | Experience | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **⚙️ Engineering** | Create Base, Aeronautics, Add-ons | Infinite automation & custom physics aircrafts. | | **🌍 Discovery** | Overhauled Worldgen, New Structures | Breathtaking biomes, hidden dungeons, and ruins. | | **🦁 Ecology** | Immersive Custom Mobs & Wildlife | A living, breathing world full of unique encounters. | --- ## 🚀 Core Pillars ### 🪐 Kinetic Engineering & Aviation * **True Mechanical Freedom:** Harness rotation, stress, and kinetic power to automate every resource. * **Aeronautics Division:** Build actual flying warships, cargo planes, or floating bases that move smoothly through the world. ### 🗺️ World Overhaul * **Next-Gen Terrain:** Experience seamless, beautiful terrain generation that begs to be explored by air. * **Loot & Danger:** Explore hand-crafted dungeons and monuments featuring unique challenges and rewarding progression. --- ## ⚡ High-End Optimization No micro-stutters. No endless loading screens. We believe high performance shouldn't be a luxury.
